rounds.prompt: Name as many of the 15 Soviet republics as you can.
rounds.blurb: Every republic of the USSR, which became 15 countries in 1991.
rounds.fact: Turkmenistan became independent in October 1991. In 1995 the UN recognised it as permanently neutral.

rounds.prompt: Name a country that was once a republic of the Soviet Union.
